siteRules.description: Choose where auto-detection prompts appear. Manual testing is unaffected.
siteRules.emptyWhitelist: No rules; all websites are allowed by default.
siteRules.exactHint: Matches the full URL, including path, query and fragment.
siteRules.invalid: Check the rules. Add at least one valid rule; editing accepts one rule at a time.
siteRules.legacyHint: Preserves the previous domain, subdomain and path-prefix matching behavior.

siteRules.placeholder: Enter a domain or URL; paste multiple lines to add in bulk.
siteRules.priorityHint: Used only when a URL matches both lists.
siteRules.regexHint: One JavaScript regular expression per line, case-insensitive. Invalid or unsafe expressions cannot be saved.
siteRules.restrictedHint: Only whitelist matches can prompt. Overlaps follow the selected priority.
